scope.summary: Implement the optional-adapter posture for account-gated interop: any format/export target requiring a provider account, cloud service, or subscription MUST be marked optional adapter (ADPT) or omitted and MUST NOT be a runtime dependency of any core matrix row. Account-gated surfaces include vendor cloud-document containers + version history, cloud asset libraries + library-linked assets, provider share-for-review + publishing, cloud media-encoder services for video render, and provider site/app publishing (.site/.make). The local-first equivalent (local document history 14.19, local fixtures, local export) is PRIMARY; the cloud path is an installable StudioModelAdapter/provider adapter that degrades cleanly to local behavior with a capability receipt when absent.
acceptance_criteria: account-gated targets are ADPT/omitted; local-first primary; degrade-to-local receipt; no core-row cloud dependency
expected_tests: negative: no core matrix row depends on a provider account/cloud service at runtime
test: cloud path is optional adapter; degrades to local behavior + capability receipt when absent

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Import & Export / Provider & cloud adapters (optional)

risk_if_missed: Cloud/account dependency creeps into core rows; offline/local-first broken.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
